label: V4.2.52
notes: Restore fast PDF export while preserving V4.2.51 left-only field authority. Remove redundant pre-sendReport applyConfig wrapper; PDF wrapper now only scopes relevant pages. Coordinate model sync no longer sanitizes/clones on every draw. Post-draw enforcement scans each SVG once instead of querySelectorAll once per field. Old coordinate draw/PDF wrappers are unwrapped to prevent stacking. MY FLIGHT optimization and Quick Incident removal preserved.
